title: Propulsion > Liquid propulsion design
captureState: Seeded fixture with engines/demo-incomplete.rw.toml (D10b: 2 unset inputs); Propulsion > System; Feed system selected; connection Tank A → Engine selected; thread 'Feed system review' with its canned exchange.
source: concepts.md §3, §4.5; spec B1; plan D10 (U2, U5, U6, U7); BC0 critic (M1.15b)

items.text: Header bar across the top, about 56 px tall, flat, with a 1 px hairline below.
Rocket mark and the wordmark 'RocketWright' (the product name, not the art's name).
Project switcher showing the loaded project name ('Research vehicle') with a ▾ menu.
Save state with a cloud icon and a relative time computed from the real last save ('Saved … ago').
Centred tabs Design | Propulsion | Simulate | Results.
Propulsion is the active tab, marked by a 2 px teal underline.
'✓ Check model' primary button: deep teal fill, 1 px teal border, white text; its state reflects the real model check result (status, issue count).
Settings gear button opening minimal settings.
Help '?' button.
Left rail, about 17% of the width, threads group above the page navigation section, hairline divider on its right.

items.source: C§3 Left rail, threads group; S:169 seeded threads
items.text: Thread rows with icon, name, and relative age: Feed system review, Tank study, Flight comparison (seeded).
The selected thread row is highlighted.
'+ New thread' row below the threads.
Titled navigation section 'Propulsion system' with a search icon and '+'.
Workspace column, about 58% of the width, between the rail and the agent pane.
Docked agent pane, about 25% of the width, full height below the header, hairline divider on its left (not a floating dock).
Pane head rendered by RocketWright above the embedded chat: thread icon and the open thread's title 'Feed system review', the same thread the left rail highlights.

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; S:169 allowed deviation; U17; D10; D31
items.text: 'Agent' settings button in the pane head that opens the agent's provider and model settings (the S:169 'Agent ▾' mapping).

items.source: C§3 Agent pane; C§2 bubble/user; D31
items.text: The user's message in a teal-tinted bubble, radius about 6 px, with the round user avatar beside it.
An `rw:` app reference in the thread renders as a chip naming the entity, not as raw text; it resolves to a stable entity id and opens that entity in RocketWright.
App tool rows for the turn's tool calls: a leading chevron that expands the call, a tool icon, the tool's label in sans, and a teal success check.
Agent reply after the turn's tool rows and cards, written as plain prose with no bubble, under the agent's name.
Composer pinned to the bottom of the agent pane.
Composer placeholder 'Ask about this design…'.
Paperclip attach button.
Send button.
Bottom-right footer of the agent pane states the provenance of the data shown (it replaces the art's placeholder footer).
Design history strip along the bottom of the rail and workspace.

items.source: C§3 Design history strip; C§6 (02); D10
items.text: Label 'Design history', then numbered step circles joined by hairlines, each with a name and date; numbers are sequential and unique, from the seeded history.
The current step has a teal ring.
'Compare' button at the end of the strip.
'⋯' menu after Compare.
Propulsion system rows: Propellant storage, Feed system, Valves, Engine assembly, Sensors, each with eye toggle and thumbnail.
Feed system row selected with the teal tint.
Page title 'Liquid propulsion' (22-28 px).
Tabs Assembly | System | Properties, System active; Properties holds the computed performance.
3D view in the upper ~55% of the workspace.
Three-quarter render of twin brushed-metal tanks with partly separated shell panels, plumbing, and an engine bell.
The selected flow path is highlighted in teal (subtle, no bloom) and matches the diagram selection.
Leader labels Storage, Feed, Engine.
'Connectivity diagram' panel, lower left.
Nodes with icons for the system graph: Tank A, Tank B (amber border), Valve A, Valve B, Engine.
Teal and amber elbow connectors with arrowheads, auto-routed.
Selecting a node, edge, or 3D part selects the same entity in the diagram, the 3D view, and the inspector.
Inspector with tabs Selected connection | Inputs | Assumptions.
From and To rows naming the selected connection's endpoints with icons.
'Fluid model: Not selected (!)', 'Boundary conditions: Required (!)', 'Analysis: Not run (i)', from the real unset inputs.
'Source references ›' link to the cited sources (NASA CEA/SP).
Tool rows for the view renders, each with a leading chevron, the tool's label and a teal success check.

items.source: C§4.5 Agent pane; C§5.2; D10 (b); D31
items.text: Amber-bordered row '⚠ Missing inputs · N' in the strip between the pane head and the embedded chat, with N from the model validation.

items.source: C§4.5 Agent pane; C§2 accent/teal-fill; D10; D31
items.text: 'Review inputs' primary button in the missing-inputs row of that strip.

items.source: C§4.5 Agent pane; C§6 (05) one owner; D10; D31
items.text: Thread-local history: the left rail lists the threads with the open one highlighted, and the strip between the pane head and the embedded chat lists this thread's steps (✓ done, ◯ current) with times; the bottom strip remains the artefact history owner and the two never disagree.
'Selected connection' is the active inspector tab, marked with the teal underline; the active tab persists with the selection.
While required inputs are unset, Analysis stays 'Not run' and the analysis action is blocked.
The node for the selected entity is outlined in teal in the diagram, distinct from the amber-bordered node.
The eye toggle on each Propulsion system row shows or hides that element in the 3D view.
Soft vertical viewport vignette with a studio key light and a contact shadow under the model and no bloom.
